subject: Final invoice
body: We've decided to wind down the final expense side of the agency at the end of the quarter. Could you send the final invoice and confirm nothing renews after that? Thanks for everything.

subject: November invoice
body: My November invoice charges 140 leads but my plan is 120. Yes, a few of those leads were weak, but that's a separate conversation. Right now I just need the invoice corrected before my bookkeeper closes the month.

subject: contact rate
body: Contact rate on the IUL leads dropped to maybe 20% this month. I'm giving it until the 15th, then I'm moving the budget to the vendor my upline uses.

subject: Great job
body: Great job team, another month with zero closed annuity cases. I'll be letting the contract lapse when it's up.

subject: Weekdays only
body: From now on please only book appointments Monday to Friday, 9 to 5 Central. Two came in on Saturday again.

subject: Urgent: DNC
body: Lead L-404 says she's on the Do Not Call list and her attorney will contact me. I need the consent record and opt-in timestamp for this lead today.

subject: replacement
body: Requesting a replacement for L-601. Number goes to a fax machine. Otherwise leads have been good this month, keep it up.

subject: Adding Ohio
body: Got my Ohio license yesterday! Please add Ohio to my debt relief campaign. By the way, the dashboard was slow this morning but it's fine now.

subject: can't see leads
body: I can't log in since this morning. Password reset email never arrives. I have appointments today and can't see the lead details.

subject: Partnership
body: Hi, I run a CRM for insurance agents and think our tools would integrate well. Who should I talk to about a partnership?

subject: Budget
body: Leads have been solid. We're doubling down next quarter: please raise our daily cap from 10 to 20 starting January 1.

subject: Refund
body: I paid for 50 leads in October and you only delivered 38. Please refund the 12 I didn't get.
